lee: Kicking off Q1 least-priv sweep tomorrow. Targeting ~180 admin-ish roles + KMS/KeyVault grant sanity check. Goal: attestation or staged revoke. cc @noah @anya

noah: Good. Can we also fold in vuln-triage outputs? I want any roles touching vaults/keys flagged by the CVE triage (CVE-2026-0421) to be on a fast path.

anya: Will do. Quick helpers I'm using to grab last-use and key grants: 
```
# AWS KMS usage from CloudTrail (last 180d)
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=Decrypt --query 'Events[?contains(Resources[0].ResourceName, `key/`)]' --max-items 1000 | jq .

# Azure Key Vault activity (last 90d)
az monitor activity-log list --resource-id /subscriptions/$SUB/vaults/$VAULT --start-time 2025-10-01 --filters "category eq 'ServiceHealth'"

# Grep role references in infra (local checkout)
grep -R "roles/" infra/ | sed -n '1,200p'
```

ops-bot: infra-bot: Opened ticket RW-SEC-1029 for sweep orchestration. Linked playbook: https://internal.redwood/playbooks/access-sweep (read-only).

lee: Schedule proposal: dry-run tagging Mon 08:00 PT; owner attestation window 10 days; removals begin 21 days after tags. Fast-path for CVE hits: 48h notice + rollback window documented.

noah: Prechecks: detect terraform/workflow refs and active CI consumers. I'll run a `ref-check` that queries our repo indexer and returns a list of dependents. If dependents > 0, auto-skip and notify owners.

anya: Evidence bundle plan: CSV of role->principal->last_auth, KMS/key snapshots, and sample audit slices. I will push to gs://redwood-sec-evidence/q1-2026 and attach SHA256 sums. Also adding a manifest.json (signed) with the provenance note.

lee: For cross-account KMS grants we found in last scan (examples: svcacct analytics-prod has decrypt in account B), triage options: 1) confirm cross-account intent via ticket/owner attestation, 2) tighten grant to specific principals via IAM conditions, 3) rotate key if grant looks compromised. Which owner takes lead?

noah: I'll take analytics-prod grant. Plan: query key policy, list grants, and check CloudTrail/KeyVault logs for usage patterns. If usage is only from account A's EC2 instances, we can tighten to `arn:aws:iam::A:role/instance-role` instead of broad service-account grants.

anya: Heads-up automation snippet to snapshot key policy and current grants: 
```
# AWS snapshot
aws kms get-key-policy --key-id alias/analytics-key --policy-name default > analytics-key-policy.json
aws kms list-grants --key-id alias/analytics-key > analytics-grants.json
sha256sum analytics-grants.json analytics-key-policy.json > sha256sums.txt

# GCP (KMS) IAM snapshot
gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy analytics-key --location=global --keyring=prod > gcp-analytics-iam.json
sha256sum gcp-analytics-iam.json >> sha256sums.txt
```

ops-bot: Note: when removing grants, please add a scheduled escalation to #incidents + a PagerDuty note in case consumers break.

lee: Removals policy: always start with `--dry-run` tag + owner email. If owner doesn't respond in 10 days, escalate to their manager and keep role in quarantine label for audit. Avoid surprise failures in prod.

noah: Rollback plan: reapply saved policy/grants from snapshot and re-deploy via infra-auth role. Keep change window 02:00-05:00 PT for low traffic.

anya: One extra: include a “recently-created-credential” exclusion window (30 days) to avoid pruning newly onboarded service accounts that haven't had time to be claimed.

lee: Action items recap: lee -> draft owner email template + playbook updates; noah -> run precheck & take analytics-prod grant; anya -> produce evidence bundle + upload + sha256; ops-bot -> attach ticket and schedule reminders.

sec-bot: Security-bot: Reminder to include attestation checklist: owner statement, logs showing last usage, CI/infra dependency check, and key policy snapshot.

noah: I'll post a short runbook for analysts doing the fast-path CVE triage (steps + common mitigations). Expect PR to docs today.

anya: Uploaded evidence bundle (gs://redwood-sec-evidence/q1-2026/attestation-20260301.tar.gz) sha256: d4b0c9f7e8b2... Will share ticket link once ops-bot attaches it.

lee: Thanks. We'll rendezvous here after dry-run results. If anything looks like active exploitation (unexpected decrypt spikes or unknown foreign principals), escalate to IR immediately.

ops-bot: Ticket RW-SEC-1029 updated with evidence link and timeline. Reminders scheduled: owner followup @ 10 days, escalation @ 11 days.

sec-bot: Acknowledged. Logging thread to audit stream.
